Nutrient cycles

What grows in the garden, stays in the garden.

What is it?

You reuse residual materials in your garden instead of removing them. What you take away (= eat) you need to replace with plant material from outside, so the soil doesn't become depleted.

Why does it work?

  • nothing is lost
  • soil stays fed
  • less input needed
  • the system grows stronger

How do you apply it?

  • leave plant remains in place or use them as mulch
  • compost what you can't use as mulch
  • top up with local material (grass clippings, leaves, prunings)
  • remove nothing, except what you eat

Nuance / when

Closing the loop happens in an instant; building up the soil takes time — around 3 years
